description: This PHP source file defines the OAuthSubscriber class, which subscribes to HTTP kernel request and response events to handle OAuth2 token validation and authentication within the OrangeHRM system. It manages OAuth token validation, user authentication, and error handling for OAuth requests, integrating with various services and traits for authentication, logging, and configuration.

classes.name: OAuthSubscriber
classes.description: A class that subscribes to HTTP kernel events to manage OAuth2 token validation and user authentication within the system, handling request validation, error responses, and session invalidation.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array of events the class subscribes to, specifically request and response events with their respective handler methods.

methods.name: getAuthenticationService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of AuthenticationService.

methods.name: onRequestEvent
methods.description: Handles the request event by checking for OAuth token in the headers, validating it, and setting the authenticated user context.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Handles exceptions during OAuth token validation, providing appropriate JSON error responses or throwing session expired exceptions.

methods.name: onResponseEvent
methods.description: Handles the response event by invalidating the session if an OAuth token was used and the user was authenticated.
